تناسقت (form VI)
# تَنَاسَقْتُ (tanāsaqtu) /ta.naː.saq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاسَقَ (tanāsaqa)
# تَنَاسَقْتَ (tanāsaqta) /ta.naː.saq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاسَقَ (tanāsaqa)
# تَنَاسَقْتِ (tanāsaqti) /ta.naː.saq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاسَقَ (tanāsaqa)
# تَنَاسَقَتْ (tanāsaqat) /ta.naː.sa.qat/: third-person fem
